0022600212.text: The 76ers host the Celtics in their 12th game of the season, sitting at 9-2 and first in the East and the Atlantic, with a 4-1 home record and an 8-2 mark over their last ten, while Boston is 7-2, second in the East and one game back in the Atlantic. The teams have not met yet this season, and their 2025-26 regular season series was split 2-2, while the 76ers won the 2025-26 playoff series 4-3, including a 109-100 win in Boston on May 2, 2026. Philadelphia will be without Adem Bona (back sprain), Ariel Hukporti (Achilles surgery), and Dominick Barlow (back fracture).
